title: Mitosis: Chromosome Behavior and Sequential Stages
method: Whitespace-delimited visible teaching prose, excluding headings, tables, SVG, captions, practice, references and controls; article count includes headings, table, captions, practice and references, excluding SVG and buttons.
comparator: 2.C.10: 8610 narrative words, 18 sections; 2.C.08: 7964 narrative words, 16 sections. This chapter covers 14 substantive teaching sections within the narrower stage-behavior scope; comparison based on explanatory coverage, not quotas.
scientific_checks: Official merged NET p.3, separate NET p.2 and archived MP SET 2024 p.2 visually checked. Alberts, Cooper, Nature Education, Cimini et al. 2001 and plant microtubule network review checked. Two editorial self-review passes clarified centromere counting, five- versus four-stage conventions, open/closed mitosis, plant spindle, attachment errors, morphology and actual evidence, compartment-specific DNA counts, population snapshot assumptions and numerical practice. Seven numbered worked examples recalculated; diagrams and question data original. Revised questions reveal explanations separately.
limitations: Two academic self-review passes, not independent human peer review. Static HTML/SVG source checks only; no browser/device interaction, visual rendering or assistive-technology audit. MP SET syllabus source is archived, not current original MPPSC-hosted file. Immediate unpublished neighbors disabled and not linked; later publication should restore reciprocal navigation. Live Pages verification pending.
